correlation_interpretation: This sample does not show excess joint absence versus the independent product; high individual loss already explains frequent loss of all four. The product is a descriptive comparison, not proof of independent RF trials.

observer_comparison.limitation: Both callbacks share lower driver/RF stages; equality does not distinguish RF erasure from loss before both callbacks. Promiscuous FCS reporting depends on filter configuration.

comparison_limit: Source adaptive reserve grew to500ms; these are descriptive windows and do not isolate RF preference as the exclusive cause of delivery changes. Balanced preference restored.
